title: Wire check-harness-current.mjs and check:pm-expected-skips self-tests into lint.yml
body:
Fixes #18356
Fixes #18358

## What changed

Two independent one-line wirings into `.github/workflows/lint.yml`, one per linked card, each landed as its own commit so `check-self-test-wired.mjs` starts counting a `--self-test` that already ships on `main` but that no workflow names.

### #18356 — `check-harness-current.mjs --self-test` into the "Shallow-history guard self-tests" collector

- Location: the `Shallow-history guard self-tests` step's `run:` block (the collector `check-step-collectors.mjs --self-test` extracts and drives).
- Before: three `run_self_test` lines (`git-history.mjs`, `check-engine-split-ratio.mjs`, `collect-release-notes.sh`), closing prose read "all three ran and passed".
- After: a fourth line — `run_self_test node scripts/pm/check-harness-current.mjs --self-test` — and the closing prose updated to "all four ran and passed" (the FAILED-branch prose is unchanged; it already names failures generically).
- Independent verification: `node scripts/check-step-collectors.mjs --self-test` (182 assertions, 5 live blocks) and `node scripts/check-step-collectors.mjs` (the live gate) both pass; `node scripts/pm/check-harness-current.mjs --self-test` passes standalone (14 of 14 cases) both before and after the wiring.

### #18358 — `pnpm check:pm-expected-skips` beside the other `check:pm-*` steps

- Location: the `check:pm-*` step block, immediately after `Settings deny-roster pin (#18281)` (`pnpm check:pm-settings-deny-roster`) and before the release-rehearsal step — the same "self-test only, live check stays a seat tool" shape as the widening-tell and prior-ruling-reader steps beside it.
- Before: no step in any workflow named `check:pm-expected-skips` or `check-expected-skips.mjs`.
- After: a new step named "Expected-skips roster self-test" running `pnpm check:pm-expected-skips`.
- Independent verification: `pnpm check:pm-expected-skips` passes locally (99 of 99 cases).

## `check-self-test-wired` — before / after

BEFORE, on origin/main at 8b81ab60d7:

```
check-self-test-wired: every one of the 212 script(s) CI runs that ship a --self-test has that self-test run by CI.
scope: 292 file(s) under scripts/, 229 carrying --self-test in code (comments masked, 1 of them package-local gate(s) CI names by path); 212 of those are run by 37 workflow(s); 209 have their self-test run through the flag, 3 through a recorded route.
```

AFTER, on this branch:

```
check-self-test-wired: every one of the 214 script(s) CI runs that ship a --self-test has that self-test run by CI.
scope: 292 file(s) under scripts/, 229 carrying --self-test in code (comments masked, 1 of them package-local gate(s) CI names by path); 214 of those are run by 37 workflow(s); 211 have their self-test run through the flag, 3 through a recorded route.
```

212 to 214 run by CI (both new scripts counted "through the flag": 209 to 211). `check-harness-current.mjs` and `check-expected-skips.mjs` are the two scripts that moved.

## Gates

Derived via `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` against merge-base `8b81ab60d` (41 commands: 21 `pnpm`, 20 direct `node`). All 40 non-lock commands ran locally and passed, except `pnpm check:type-check-debt`, which reported PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3, not a finding — the ledgered packages' workspace dependencies have no built dist type entry point in this worktree; the script's own text says a re-measure without the closure built would silently measure a different world). `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (single-machine roughly 430 to 450 seconds) ran through the shared verify lock.

`node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test .github/workflows/lint.yml` reports NOT governed at exit 0, as expected for a workflow-only diff. `node scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs --pair 18388` reports both cards' clause-2 declaration readable in the fixed spelling, both carriers agreeing, and no widening tell on either diff (exit 0).

## skip-changeset

No published package's shipped content moves — the diff is entirely inside `.github/workflows/lint.yml`, which is not published. `skip-changeset` applied.

## Acceptance notes

None — both cards' file surfaces were exactly as scoped (one collector line plus its closing prose, one new step), and no reproducible defect, contract violation or metadata-authoring trap was found while touching this file.
